name: GBG monorepo (bun + Nx)
install: command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1 || curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash; export BUN_INSTALL="$HOME/.bun"; export PATH="$BUN_INSTALL/bin:$PATH"; bun install --frozen-lockfile || bun install --frozen-lockfile

terminals.name: tmnl-web (vite)
terminals.command: export BUN_INSTALL="$HOME/.bun"; export PATH="$BUN_INSTALL/bin:$PATH"; cd packages/tmnl && bunx vite
